inputs.acceptance_evidence: Read array_view.py, measurement_frame.py, and reader.py's load()/loads() mode parameter in full before writing any documentation. Verified every new README code example end-to-end against real, freshly constructed NRRD data (not merely signature-inspected): (1) a NRRD0005 document with a real 'measurement frame' header field, loaded via load(), then build_measurement_frame_transform(measurement_frame=document.header['measurement frame'], space_dimension=3).measurement_to_world((1.0,0.0,0.0)) correctly returned (1.0,0.0,0.0) for an identity frame; (2) array_view()/.crop()/.flip()/.permute()/.copy() run against a real 2x3 int8 view -- confirmed shape=(2,3), strides=(1,2), flip negates strides, and only .copy() sets copied=True; (3) load(data, mode='recovery') against a raw payload with 3 excess trailing bytes beyond its declared 6-byte shape correctly reported recovery_actions=('raw payload had 3 extra trailing byte(s) beyond the declared 6-byte shape; discarded',), and the identical data under mode='strict' correctly raised ResourceLimitError instead of silently recovering. All referenced symbols (array_view, NrrdArrayView, AxisMetadata, NrrdDtype, build_measurement_frame_transform, MeasurementFrameTransform, load, get_array) confirmed present on the installed format_factory.nrrd module via hasattr.

5. 6.
